raw_block.rationale: Revise the retained airline calculator to eliminate the unresolved combined base-fee read and the misread band boundaries. Stable numerical boundaries are grounded as source premises, while one joint reader supplies the route-and-cabin-specific fee arrays.

skill.intent: Calculate the exact integer ticket price plus all accepted current-bag fees, allowing one dimension-compliant carry-on and combining checked, overweight, and oversize charges correctly.

outputs.description: Exact current ticket price plus all accepted carry-on, checked-bag, overweight, and oversize fees.

origin.quote: You can bring only one carry-on item along with your personal item.

source_obligations.statement: Treat at most one dimension-compliant ordinary bag as the free carry-on.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate checked-bag linear size by summing all three outside dimensions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When both excess dimensions and excess weight apply, add only the higher excess fee to the checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: What is the exact integer ticket plus fees for every current bag?

source_obligations.statement: Return one exact integer containing the ticket price and fees for every current bag.

source_provenance.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size.
All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination.
